name: Adaptable Circulation
effect: Medical Toughness is increased by 1. Can be taken multiple times.

name: Ambidextrous
effect: The Protagonist can use either hand equally good, gaining the \emph{Off-Hand Expert} ability for free. The abilities \emph{Dual Wielding} and \emph{Maneuver: Flurry} only cost half.

name: Aptitude
effect: Adds +5 to a characteristic which doesn't count against investment limits. Can be taken multiple times but only once per characteristic.

name: Augmented
effect: The Protagonist starts the game with augmentation. Limits depend on the boon's level: \begin{enumerate} \item 1 RI/MT, cR 150 \item 2 RI/MT, cR 350 \item 4 RI/MT, cR 600 \end{enumerate}

name: Balance
effect: Tests to prevent falling over are at a +20. Improves on Steadfast and doesn't stack.

name: Battle Trance
effect: The Protagonist can enter a battle trance. This takes two actions and causes one level of exhaustion. He becomes frenzied but can identify friend and foe and return to normal by spending two actions.

name: Big Spender
effect: The Protagonist gains additional equipment worth up to \(2 * Ch * level\) of this boon. The money can only be spent at character creation and unused credits are wasted. Particular equipment may as always be restricted by the Adjudicator. Cannot be combined with Destitute.

name: Born Hero
effect: The Protagonist counts as having all prerequisites for the Abilities Heroic, On your feet! and Personified Inspiration. These abilities only cost half as much.

name: Broad Education
effect: The Protagonist may choose a second background and gain +1 to its Skills and Educations, as well as all its Boons, Banes and Abilities.

name: Combat Academic
effect: All maneuver abilities only cost 25% of their original cost.

name: Dark Vision
effect: The Protagonist only takes half penalties in low light but normal penalties in complete darkness.

name: Diver's Lung
effect: The Protagonist may hold her breath twice as long.

name: Euphonia
effect: The Protagonist has a commonly beautiful voice. He gains a +10 to social interaction tests when the target can hear him. This also makes Voice Athlete a basic skill.

name: Formal Education
effect: Grants 50 XP to be spent only on educations. Can be taken multiple times.

name: Fortune's Child
effect: Every session the Protagonist may re-roll one of her dice rolls or one that she is directly affected by.

name: Giant
effect: The Protagonist becomes two categories larger. He is easier to hit, has more melee range, is faster and more imposing.

name: Good Reputation
effect: The Protagonist has some sort of good reputation, either from well known deeds or from known genetic markers. If he is talking to someone who knows of this, he gains a bonus equal to 5 times the boon's level. Can be taken up to level 10.

name: Heroic Characteristic
effect: Whenever the Protagonist succeeds at a test against his Heroic Characteristic, he scores an additional 2 DoS. This requires an Aptitude in the same characteristic already.

name: Iron Resilience
effect: Degradation from wounds is reduced by one step. Bleeding starts as normal.

name: Large
effect: The Protagonist becomes a category larger. He is easier to hit, has more melee range, is faster and more imposing.

name: Looker
effect: The Protagonist is beautiful. She gains +5 to social interaction tests. Not compatible with Smoking, Ugly and Physically Repulsive.

name: Low Libido
effect: The Protagonist has very little interest in getting frisky. This makes it near impossible for him to be involved in seduction attempts on either side, adding a -25 penalty to seduction tests targeting him or being performed by him.

name: Natural Armor
effect: The Protagonist has natural armor covering her skin. Adds +1 armor to every location and can be taken up to 8 times.

name: Nerves Of Steel
effect: Rayleigh Index is increased by 1. Can be taken multiple times.

name: Night Vision
effect: The Protagonist only takes half penalties in complete darkness and no penalties in low light.

name: Nimble
effect: Speed is increased by 1 and dodging penalties are reduced by 10.

name: Outstanding Sense
effect: Grants +20 to tests based on the chosen sense. Counts as a Trained Sense for the purposes of prerequisites, the bonuses will however still add up. Not compatible with Impaired Sense for the same sense.

name: Personal Possession
effect: The Protagonist owns a very special, valuable (up to 800cr) item with not only large material but especially high sentimental value. This may include sets of items such as two bionic arms, but those are are up to the Adjudicator's discretion even more than usual.

name: Pleasant Smell
effect: If the target of the Protagonist's charming social test can smell him, the test gains +10. Not compatible with Terrible odor.

name: Poison Resistance
effect: When the Protagonist starts being effected by a chem, he may make a Con test. On a success he ignores the effects.

name: Privileged Access
effect: The Protagonist gains a 25% discount for license-free equipment made by a certain company. During character creation this bonus is 50% instead to account for sales in the past. He also has access to limited, rare equipment made and/or sold by the company. Any roll for Availability (see p. \pageref{sec:availability}) gains a +1 (again, specific to the trade partner). Requires Good Reputation with that company / salesman.

name: Quick Regeneration
effect: Grants +30 to natural regeneration tests.

name: Smoking
effect: The Protagonist is extremely physically attractive or otherwise imposing. He gains +15 to social interaction tests but -20 to hide because his appearance is extremely memorable and outstanding. Not compatible with Looker, Ugly and Physically repulsive. If the Protagonist already is a Looker, this can replace it for 7 GP.

name: Social Chameleon
effect: The Protagonist has extreme ease fitting into any social group. Trying to pass as someone of a different class, sex, origin, and so on gain +40.

name: Stoic
effect: Halves net penalties or doubles net bonuses on fear tests.

name: Superior Balance
effect: Tests to prevent falling over are at a +30. Improves on Balance and doesn't stack.

name: Tough As Nails
effect: The Protagonist can continue acting while bleeding until completely bled out. He never starts \emph{severe bleeding}.

name: Unbridled Rage
effect: Any check to enter a berserk or frenzy state is at a +20 and any check to resist or return from such a state is at a -20.

name: Unrivaled Flexibility
effect: Agile without peer, it’s easy for the Protagonist to squeeze through tight spaces. He gains a +30 when attempting to release himself from holds or to escape from being tied up.

name: Veteran
effect: The Protagonist is older and more experienced. He gains another +1 to all Skills and Educations in his Background.
